an10.65:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Sāriputto Magadhesu viharati Nālakagāmake.
an10.65:1.2: Atha kho Sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako yenāyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi,
an10.65:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca
an10.65:2.1: ‘kin nu kho āvuso Sāriputta sukhaṃ kiṃ dukkhan' ti? 2.
an10.65:2.2: Abhinibbatti kho āvuso dukkhā, anabhinibbatti sukhā.
an10.65:2.3: Abhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an10.65:2.4: sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo aggisamphasso daṇḍasamphasso satthasamphasso ñātī pi naṃ mittā pi saṅgamma samāgamma rosenti.
an10.65:2.5: Abhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ. 3.
an10.65:2.6: Anabhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ sukhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an10.65:2.7: na sītaṃ na unhaṃ na jighacchā na pipāsā na uccāro na passāvo na aggisamphasso na daṇḍasamphasso na satthasamphasso ñātī pi naṃ mittā pi saṅgamma samāgamma na rosenti.
an10.65:2.8: Anabhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ sukhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhan
